sources.snippet: This model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the multilingual MTEB leaderboard as of October 21, 2025. This guide provides step-by-step instructions to reproduce the training pipeline for the llama-embed-nemotron-8b model using NeMo AutoModel framework.
